name: @pas/wasm
description: Wraps the pa-wasm crate so Turborepo drives wasm-pack as an ordinary workspace package. No experimental Cargo flag required. The entry points target pkg/, which wasm-pack generates and .gitignore excludes: it is a build artefact and must never be committed, or the committed copy and the built one will drift. The boundary's TypeScript types are exported from types/, which pa-app's tests generate from the Rust types and which is committed, never edited by hand.
